New York City is home to thousands of Haitian families who came here fleeing violence and instability. Today, their Temporary Protected Status comes to an end.

I’m calling on the Senate to pass the bipartisan House-passed TPS extension immediately. Turning our backs on Haitian families now would be a moral failure.
posts.summary: Calls for Senate to extend Temporary Protected Status for Haitian families

posts.text:
Today, I signed the discharge petition for the American Dream and Promise Act.

Dreamers and TPS holders who built their lives here deserve certainty, not the threat of deportation hanging over them every day.

House Republicans refuse to bring this bill to the floor. House Democrats will force a vote ourselves.
posts.summary: Backs American Dream and Promise Act, opposes deportation threats to Dreamers and TPS holders

posts.text:
When a public official is absent for an extended period of time, the public has a right to an honest explanation.

I'm introducing the Duty of Transparency Act to require Members to disclose extended absences so constituents know where their representative is.
posts.summary: Introduces transparency bill requiring disclosure of extended absences

A young man is dead because an ICE agent pulled the trigger in Biddeford, Maine. He was 26. 

Behind every headline like this is a family whose lives have been shattered. The callousness of this administration's immigration agenda has a body count.
